title: Dos Boy - HEALTHY
htmlContent:
Australia rapper and songwriter Dos Boy shares a new track "HEALTHY", a first single from album "Horrorscope". "HEALTHY" is a special piece of audio that serves it purpose. It’s a record that goes beyond just good sounds to hear, but a masterpiece that connects to the listener on a body and soul level.

Dos Boy brings a vibrant summer smash on his new song “HEALTHY”. The music wastes little time making an engaging experience, with a bright sound full of bounce in the production that sets the ultimate tone for the work he delivers. His infectious charisma carries the song to the fullest, with a swagger that make you buy in to the music, as he delivers the fun writing with ease to make it a complete package of artistry for us all to have more life.
